ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain The school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Initiating a class income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
